notablePrerequisites: Tekuthal has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Tekuthal using Myojin of Towering Might's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, putting five +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite, and three +1/+1 counters on any creature you control.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Tekuthal by paying {3} and removing three +1/+1 counters from Cryptic Trilobite, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
